description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog plugin for inserting or editing 'hidden' input fields within the editor. It specifies dialog behavior, including setup and commit methods for dialog fields, and handles inserting or updating hidden input elements in the editor's document.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new dialog called 'hiddenfield' to the CKEDITOR object with the specified configuration.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Triggered when the dialog is shown; prepares the dialog content based on the selected element.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Triggered when the OK button is pressed; inserts or updates a hidden input element in the editor content.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Initializes dialog fields based on the selected element's attributes.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Updates the selected element's attributes based on the dialog input fields.
